name: Organisation Type 2
definition: Specifies a type of identification requested for an organisation.

AnyBIC.name: Any BIC
AnyBIC.definition: Business identification code of the organisation is requested.||Usage: When absent (default value), the identification is not requested.

LEI.name: LEI
LEI.definition: Legal entity identification as an alternate identification for a party is requested.||Usage: When absent (default value), the identification is not requested.

EmailAddress.name: Email Address
EmailAddress.definition: Address for electronic mail (e-mail) is requested.||Usage: When absent (default value), the identification is not requested.

Other.name: Other
Other.definition: Unique identification of an organisation, as assigned by an institution, using an identification scheme is requested.
